Answer the multiple-choice question below.

Question:
Simulate a solution of pure water at pH 7 and 150°C at equilibrium with 10 moles of chrysotile and 10 moles of talc.

What is the molality of MgOH+?

A. 6.818e-06
B. 6.814e-06
C. 6.816e-06
D. 6.817e-06

Use tools as needed for PHREEQC / quantitative work.

tool_calls.name: write_file
tool_calls.arguments:
{"path":"chrys_talc.inp","new_content":"SOLUTION 1 Pure water
    temp 150
    pH 7 charge

EQUILIBRIUM_PHASES 1
    Chrysotile 0 10
    Talc 0 10

END
"}
